treatment_summary.value: Oral corticosteroids (prednisolone 40 mg daily) with improvement but steroid dependence; DMARDs hydroxychloroquine, azathioprine and methotrexate, all largely ineffective; tocilizumab (IV 8 mg/kg monthly), started before the genetic diagnosis, with an excellent response; discontinued long-term corticosteroids and remains well controlled on tocilizumab monotherapy for the last 2 years.

disease_label_as_stated.value: HA20 (A20 haploinsufficiency); previously diagnosed with AOSD (adult-onset Still's disease)

clinical_diagnosis_basis.value: AOSD diagnosed at age 21 based on typical clinical features associated with hyperferritinemia and exclusion of other autoimmune rheumatological diagnoses; HA20 established by exome sequencing (novel heterozygous TNFAIP3 variant), Sanger segregation in family members, cDNA splicing analysis and Western blot showing A20 haploinsufficiency.

age_at_onset_original_text.value: symptomatic from the age of 8 months

treatment_summary.value: Regular colchicine; no further inflammatory episodes or symptoms since commencing it.

age_at_last_evaluation_original_text.value: a boy aged 6 and a half

treatment_summary.value: Colchicine, not as effective as in his sister; currently awaiting therapeutic trial of tocilizumab.

functional_evidence_statement.value: Proband PBMC cDNA showed a mutant allele with deletion of exon 8 (alternatively spliced mRNA); loss of transcript by nonsense-mediated decay resulting in A20 haploinsufficiency confirmed by Western blot; greater percentage of CD14+ monocytes p65-positive after LPS than healthy controls (not statistically significant); increased IL-1beta and IL-18 after LPS+ATP (attenuated by NLRP3 inhibitor MCC950), increased TNFalpha, IL-10, IL-17alpha, IL-1alpha and IL-8 but not IL-6; significantly higher serum ASC specks than healthy control range. Variant not found in ExAC; allele frequency 2.191e-5 on GnomAD.
